outcome: Body mass index (BMI) trajectory from birth to 2 years old
cohort: 19,054 children born in Taizhou, China, from 2018 to 2019 with at least three BMI measurements after birth
finding: Three distinct BMI trajectories were identified (lower, middle, upper), and infants in the middle and upper trajectories had a higher risk of being overweight/obese at 2 years old.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to be correlated with infant BMI trajectories.
